pages.text: The Akaishi Plant Cultivator grows seeds and stalks into crops; the seed stays in its slot and is $(bold)never consumed$(reset), so one machine can operate indefinitely.$(br2)$(bold)Usage:$(reset) place a seed in the input slot and supply Akaishi Energy. Each operation takes 200 ticks at 10 energy/tick with a 100k internal buffer.$(li)Wheat, Beetroot, Melon or Pumpkin Seeds → the matching crop$(li)Carrot, Potato → the same item$(li)Sugar Cane, Cactus, Bamboo, Cocoa Beans, Nether Wart → the same item$(li)Mushrooms, Crimson and Warped Fungus → the same item$(br2)Output only appears in the output slot, never seeds. Item pipes can be connected for a fully automated farm, or upgrades can be fitted to increase speed.

The Cultivator grows, the Pulverizer grinds and the Compressor presses; together with the other machines in this chapter they form an automated farm. Crystal materials are covered in $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).
